annotations.title: Ask a web page a question, with verified quotes

description: AI question answering over one live web page or document URL: an answer drawn only from the page text, verbatim quotes with character offsets checked against the page, an answerable flag and low/medium/high confidence. answerable:false (page lacks the answer) is a normal, charged 200 result. Without a question: summary, key points, title. Also final URL, page size, truncation flag. Generated by Anthropic Claude under a fixed Kit Rx prompt; may miss or misstate details. Price: $0.004 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged. AI-generated answer; a call with no arguments returns the stored example answer without a model call.

max_chars.description: Characters of the page's main content (as Markdown) read, 1000 to 30000. Default 30000. Longer pages are cut and flagged truncated.

mode.description: answer (default when q is given: answer, verbatim quotes with offsets, answerable flag, confidence) or summary (default without q: summary, key points, title).

q.description: Question to answer from the page, up to 500 characters. Omit it for a summary.
examples: From what do governments derive their just powers, according to this document?

url.description: http or https URL of a public page (HTML, or a PDF/DOCX/XLSX document; a bare domain is fetched as https://). Default ports only; credentials, IP addresses, localhost and private or single-label names are rejected.

name: web_read
